source: Original actual WinBox UI captures; no UI text/state/result substitution
scenario: Static route on TN-LAB-R1 to simulated remote LAN 198.51.100.0/24 attached to TN-LAB-R2 loopback; management loopback-only, no office LAN bridging
display_note: Captured from the Linux guest Xvfb framebuffer (1536x816 window). This session's WinBox ran without an OS title-bar decoration (earlier 39-image set included one); the bottom status bar with TN-LAB-R1 / 127.0.0.1:18291 / CHR / 7.25.1 is visible in every capture and is the connection evidence. All ten captures share one consistent session state.
callout_rule: Callout boxes are CSS presentation overlays (tn-lab-shot-rN classes in visual-refresh.css); original PNG pixels stay unchanged. Clicking a figure opens the unmodified original.
